d.ko: Click the Button은 버튼을 클릭하여 놀라운 보상을 제공하는 상자를 받는 방치형 게임입니다. 스킬을 향상시켜 가장 강한 자가 되세요.
d.en: Click the Button is an incremental game about clicking a button to receive chests that deliver incredible rewards. Improve your skills to become the strongest.
d.zh: Click the Button is an incremental game about clicking a button to receive chests that deliver incredible rewards. Improve your skills to become the strongest.
